info.longName: DFA U.S. High Relative Profitability Portfolio – ETF Class Shares

funds_data.description: The Portfolio is designed to purchase a broad and diverse group of readily marketable securities of large U.S. companies that the Advisor determines to have high profitability relative to other U.S. large cap companies at the time of purchase. An equity issuer is considered to have high profitability because it has high earnings or profitsfrom operations in relation to its book value or assets.
